Dhammanvayo.g: dhammassa paccakkhato ñāṇassa anuyogaṁ anugantvā uppannaṁ anumānañāṇaṁ nayaggāho vidito.
paccakkhañāṇasaṅkhātassa dhammassa anunayo anumānaṁ, anubuddhīti attho.
dhammassa paccakkhato ñāṇassa2 anuyogaṁ anugantvā uppannaṁ anumānañāṇaṁ nayaggāho vidito, sāvakapāramīñāṇe ṭhatvāva iminā ākārena jānāmi Bhagavāti vadati.
